gaps.lead: As I get older, I become less patient.
gaps.sentence: The older I get, ___ I become.
gaps.explanation: The older…, the more… — doubled comparatives for parallel change.

gaps.lead: He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: couldn't = was not able to (general ability in the past).

gaps.lead: 'I never wrote that review,' the chef insisted.
The instructions only made sense after she had read them twice.
gaps.sentence: The instructions ___ sense until she had read them twice.
gaps.explanation: made sense only after = didn't make sense until.

gaps.lead: 'We are closing the factory,' the board announced.
gaps.sentence: The board announced that ___ the factory.
gaps.explanation: we → they; present continuous → past continuous: they were closing.

gaps.lead: The tickets cost so much that we stayed at home.
gaps.sentence: They were ___ we stayed at home.
gaps.explanation: so much (money) → such expensive tickets (no article with plurals).
